name: Leslie Hutchins Conservation Foundation grants
summary: Grants from a southern New Zealand charitable trust for conservation work in Otago, Southland, Stewart Island and the Sub-Antarctic Islands, alongside nature-based education programmes. Trustees review applications quarterly.

geography.label: Otago, Southland, Stewart Island and the Sub-Antarctic Islands

calls.label: Trustees meeting 24 November 2026
calls.note: Applications must arrive at least two weeks before the 24 November 2026 meeting

status.quote: The Trustees will be meeting to review grant applications on February 24th, May 26th, August 25th and November 24th 2026. To be eligible, applications must be submitted at least two weeks prior to each meeting date.

geography.quote: To assist in conservation in Otago, Southland, Stewart Island or the Sub-Antarctic Islands

access.quote: Please submit your most recent financial statements and any other supporting documentation to lhcf@realnz.com
